verdicts.reason: A keeps the original three-column structure and leaves the stained-glass window some margin above and below. Its flaws are that the headline has shrunk a little, the date/address block is small and light at banner size, and the right column sits closer to the edge than the left. B has the same layout, but the window touches the top and bottom of the canvas, so it looks jammed or cropped rather than placed with intent, and its left margin is tighter. The date text is just as small in B.
